releases.name: Save The President
releases.summary:
The bodyguard has only a few seconds to save the most important man in the world. Does he have what it takes?

Suit up, put on your sunglasses, and get ready for the most stressful job on the planet! In Save The President, you are a bodyguard tasked with protecting the President from imminent threats during public speeches and official events.

But be careful: react too soon and you could cause a national scandal. Hesitate for even a second, and the consequences could be fatal!

When a gunman’s laser sight appears in the crowd, the clock starts ticking. You’ll have only seconds to make the right move: leap heroically toward the podium, neutralize the gunman hiding in the crowd, or put yourself directly in the line of fire and take the bullet to save the President.

The future of the nation depends on your reflexes.

Save the President at any cost!

releases.name: Parkour Obby: Food Escape
releases.summary:
Parkour Obby: Food Escape is a fast-paced obstacle course where every level is made out of delicious food. Jump across giant burgers and parkour your way to the finish!

FEATURES:
>Food-themed parkour levels
>Checkpoints to help you keep progressing
>Hardcore Mode with all checkpoints disabled
>Challenging obstacles and levels

releases.name: Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop
releases.summary:
The story unfolds in the tranquil village of Frune. The protagonist, a young girl named Lilia, begins her journey as a dressmaker, using the “sewing magic” she inherited from her grandmother.

As she fulfills requests from the villagers and works toward becoming a legendary dressmaker, her everyday life of dressmaking begins.

With a friendly guide and simple controls, even children can enjoy the game with peace of mind.

releases.name: Mister Scary - Where Are You?
releases.summary: Help Mister Scary find his missing family in a spooky retro platforming adventure filled with monsters, bosses, secrets, and Halloween fun!

releases.name: Cargo Rail Tycoon
releases.summary: Cargo Rail Tycoon is a trading and train-driving game set on the railways of Michigan. You are a freight entrepreneur with one simple goal: turn a small convoy and a modest bankroll into a rail empire. Buy goods where they are cheap, load your wagons, and haul them across the map to the towns that need them most — profit is made on the journey, not on the spot.But this isn't a game you play from a spreadsheet. Every trip puts you in the cab. You drive the train yourself: open the throttle on the straights, ease off through the curves — brake too late and you derail — and read the signs at each switch to reach the right town. Bandits may block the tracks; stop and haggle the ransom down, or pay the price. Arrive fast for a bonus, but arrive at the right destination or lose out.Between journeys you negotiate face-to-face with each town's station master. Haggle their margin down before you trade — offer low, and watch them squirm — then choose your next destination wisely and roll out again. Twenty-six towns are waiting, and the farther north you push, the bigger the rewards for those willing to travel.Turn cargo into cash, cash into a bigger convoy, and a bigger convoy into a fortune — just don't go bankrupt on the way.Key features-Trade across 26 towns — a living supply-and-demand economy where prices rise and fall. Find the routes, corner the goods, grow your cash.-Drive every train — first-person rail journeys where speed, curves, braking and route choices are all yours. Go too fast and you derail; take the wrong turn and you arrive at the wrong town.-Haggle every deal — negotiate the station master's margin down with a multi-round back-and-forth. Push too hard and he'll dig in.-Bandit roadblocks — stop and negotiate the ransom, or plough through and pay for it.-Build your convoy — buy wagons matched to your cargo and expand your train as your business grows.-A fresh route every trip — procedurally generated railways with curves, bridges, rivers and scenery, and a destination that can lie straight ahead, left or right — follow the signs.-Explore the whole map — the far-north towns pay the best prices, rewarding the boldest hauls.

releases.name: Funi Raccoon Game
releases.summary:
Funi Raccoon Game, a 3D Platformer Collectathon. You play as a raccoon who has recently acquired a new home (Dumpster).

Home is where the stuff is, but your home is pretty empty. Fill up your dumpster with cool, unique stuff. The more stuff you have, the more places you can go! Travel the lands, "help" the locals, and solve puzzles -- all in the aim to get more stuff!?!

releases.name: Screaming Halls: Horror
releases.summary:
You wake up in a dark hallway with no memory of how you got there. The exit is locked by an ancient curse, and the only way to break it is to find every cursed voodoo doll hidden throughout the endless corridors.

But something else roams the halls.

releases.name: Kesu-Ji
releases.summary:
KESU-JI is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics.

Aim for the top of the World Rankings in each mode! Your scores are accumulated into a Total Score to compete in the overall rankings.

Use your Total Score to unlock rewards: perks that give you an edge, or new skins and music for a change of pace.

Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

releases.name: My Sexy Boss: Office Romance Boys
releases.summary: Periscopes Down!You're Commanding your own submarine and the hunt for the enemy is on. You and your naval crew scour the depths of the ocean while looking for gold when all of a sudden you are and your submarine is under attack by enemy submarines and their torpedoes. Watch out for those old WWII mines floating around on the sea floor as well as the toxic drums come your way. Use your missiles to destroy the enemies and claim your gold! ---------------- Here's how the game works: Game play is simple and becomes more challenging as you avoid obstacles: - Press down on the screen to float upward toward the surface.  Let go of the screen to drift downward toward the sea floor. - Tap the right side of your screen to fire your missiles at the enemy subs. - Collect the Gold coins to unlock more advanced submarines to fight with. - The longer you play, the faster the game moves. Each time you play Angry Battle Submarines, it changes so you never play the same game twice - Gamecenter Leaderboards let you see how you score compared to other players by how long you're able to survive and grab medals of valor - Challenge your friends to beat your score!

releases.name: Cat Magnifier
releases.summary: JET SHOOT GAME:It's a wonderful shooting game.You will be able to shoot jet fighter with missiles and with speed.Have Fun enjoying the Action of defending against Air Strikes!!!!!

releases.name: Canvas Puzzle
releases.summary: This is a Puzzle game , try to move out the green wood out of the screen.If you try your can't let it go.**** Compatible with iPhone 5 , 4S , 4 and 3GSThe game has 14 stages in beginner level and 22 stages in advance level.Enjoy it and refer it to your friends.

releases.summary: Astro Adventurer have safely landed, however Astro will need to jump his way to the Top of Monsters Mountain to obtain Energy.Astro need your help to reach the Top, it will not be easy with monsters in his way.Can you help him jump to the Top so he can carry on his mission?This is the first series of Astro Adventurer adventures - Astro Jump.Features:Platform (Fixed/Moving/one Time)Monsters (Platform/Flying)Fire Shield (Protection)Wing Boots (Flying)Spring Shoes (Jump Boost)Magnet (Attract Coins)Fun, engaging, challenging. releases.name: Aery - Calm Horizon 2
releases.summary:
This game is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect magical crystals that mark certain landscapes. 

Because there are no enemies or any other danger in this game you will be able to lean back and enjoy the scenery and the sensation of flying. It is a great game for relaxing and calming down after an exhausting day full of hassle. 

Of course, you can always select the level that you feel helps most to relax yourself. Most levels can be finished quite quickly so that you can freely choose spend time exploring the environment but you don’t have to stay for too long if you are just looking for a short moment of peace and enjoyment. 

This game features a collection of some the most beautiful sceneries from the Aery franchise. 
We hope you like them. So lean back and take a deep breath…

releases.name: Soup Weather
releases.summary: A short narrative exploration game in which you play as Bean, an unemployed, 20-something, smart-ass. Wander around town, play mini games, feed the geese, and get to know the neighbours as Bean’s sanity begins to slip...

releases.name: TOYCRAFTER
releases.summary:
You were once a dedicated toycrafter, spending hours working alone in your workshop. But recently you lost your passion for your trade. 

Working on small toys no longer satisfies you. You shifted your focus towards something more grand, more robust.

Cut, paint and attach doll parts to build unique and unsettling sculptures. Ignore any anomalies you see or hear.

releases.name: Heartworm
releases.summary: Pass through the threshold and enter a world born of memories. Defend yourself with a camera while solving death’s mysteries in a reverent evolution of 90’s survival horror, integrating both fixed cameras and over the shoulder perspectives.

releases.name: Balloon Bomber
releases.summary:
"BALLOON BOMBER" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Control the anti-aircraft gun and destroy the balloon bombs as they gently sway through the air.
However, destroying the balloon bombs is no easy task. Aim and shoot so your bullets hit only the bomb itself.
If your shot hits the balloon instead, the bomb will fall and blow a hole in the ground. Be careful, as the anti-aircraft gun cannot pass over holes, narrowing your movement range.

releases.name: Seek
releases.summary:
In this unique survival horror game, classical music intertwines with psychological terror to create an oppressive, chilling atmosphere. You play Alice, an ordinary girl who wakes up to find herself trapped in a bizarre, ever-changing world. A snowbound orphanage, monsters lurking in the shadows, and intricate puzzles—every step is fraught with danger and uncertainty.

To survive, you must gather supplies, evade pursuit, and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness. But as the truth gradually comes to light, can you bear the cruel reality behind it all?

Gameplay features:
Action Shooting
Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies

Map Exploration
Explore the eerie orphanage step by step, collecting items to unlock new areas while confronting unexplained changes that may occur without warning

Resource Management
Gather and make prudent use of limited resources, and do whatever it takes to survive

Puzzle Solving
Gather clues, solve a wide range of puzzles, and uncover the final truth

releases.name: Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party?
releases.summary: A strategic board game-style RPG where dice rolls guide your journey! Build your deck, explore changing maps, and face events shaped by your choices and luck. Play solo or online with friends—every adventure is a new experience!

releases.name: Down Pit
releases.summary:
Down Pit is a relaxed mining platform game set across many off-world underground locations. You are a cuboid mining unit with a singular skill set sent out to extract ore from strange underground places.

There’s unlimited money to make with just you and all those mining areas to destroy, one block at a time. You arrive ready to mine, all equipment supplied, all ready to work. All the money is yours because only you will mine it out.

releases.name: Spin & Drip! Wet Guy Puzzle
releases.summary:
Spin & Drip! Wet Guy Puzzle is a casual photo puzzle featuring charming guys in refreshing water-themed scenes - from pools and beaches to waterfalls and showers.

As you advance, the photos are divided into more panels, gradually raising the challenge. If you get stuck, a hint can straighten out one uncertain row. You can use up to three hints, making it easy to enjoy even if puzzles aren’t your specialty.

Perfect for anyone who enjoys handsome, muscular guys, romantic vibes, refreshing scenes, quick casual puzzles, or testing their observation and intuition.
